questions.text: To confirm: temporary approval is granted automatically when the tenant submits the onboarding form at first sign-up, even with no certificate uploaded. So this flow starts at 'upload certificate' and then goes to Super Admin review, then Ratified or Stopped. Is that right?

Is there a deadline for uploading the certificate while the hospital is temporarily approved (for example, 30 days)? If it passes with no upload, what happens: nothing, reminders only, or service stops automatically?
What does 'stopped' mean for the hospital's users: fully locked out, read-only (can view and export existing patient data but not add new records), or something else? Is existing patient data kept?

If the Super Admin rejects the certificate, can the tenant upload a corrected one for another review, or is 'stopped' final unless the Super Admin reverses it? Should the Super Admin enter a reason that the tenant can see?

How is the tenant told about their status (Temporary / Under review / Ratified / Stopped): only in the app, or also by email/SMS? And once ratified, can the tenant replace the certificate (for example, when it is renewed), and does that trigger a new review?
